components.label: Output Layer

cards.title: The five internal layers, in order
items: Lexical — scrub_source / _logical_statements strip comments and strings, keep line anchors
Parser — parse_file / analyze_calls / resolve_call turn text into call sites
Data — MatlabFunction / MatlabClass / MatlabFile are the in-memory model
Analysis — impact, dependency and risk metrics, the static checks, taint, duplicate fingerprints
Render — render_* assembles report / browse / json / sarif output

cards.title: Why it is one file
items: The whole kernel ships as matlabc.py with no third-party dependency and no install step
Only the Python 3 standard library is used, so a 3.6.5 interpreter is enough

cards.title: Five output families
items: Machine data: JSON, XML, Doxygen XML
CI: SARIF 2.1.0 plus the persisted gate snapshot
Fix loop: patch, test stub, PR description draft
